system.description:
Education in Science covers techniques of inquiry, modern studies and a broad range of underpinning work. It requires an area of particular study — Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Metallurgy, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Geology, Botany and more — each a separate Ability.

Using a branch of Science usually requires a Mental Challenge to determine the success of research or theoretical work. Combining a Science with other Abilities yields varied results, and actually constructing a theorized device may require Crafts.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
